lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light-intensity pixel values on the upper surface and shadow-level values on the lower surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the distal trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
